description: Ask ToolRouter to build a tool that does not exist yet. Use this when discover returned nothing useful for what the user needs. Describe the capability in plain terms — do not include personal data, API keys, or secrets. Requests go straight to the team. Limit: 5 per hour.

agent_context.description: MCP client name and version, if known.

searched.description: The discover query you tried that came back empty.

what.description: What the tool should do, in one or two sentences (e.g. "Look up UK company filings by company number").

why.description: What the user was trying to accomplish and why existing tools did not fit.

name: feedback_request_tool
title: Request a Tool
